name: Fredericksburg (United States)
description: Banner of the city arms: white with a blue saltire, charged with two crossed golden maces and a small red shield bearing the city badge at the top.
history: Fredericksburg is an independent city in Virginia. The flag was adopted in 1971 (one of a series of heraldic symbols based on the arms designed by Colonel Harry D. Temple and adopted by the city in 1971, according to Flags of the World citing the city administrator's office).

features.role: small red shield with the city badge
